ImageDescription.value:
Stroganoff Ingredients:

2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces 1 large (1 cup) onion, chopped 2 tablespoons French Dip Concentrated Au Jus Sauce* 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh garlic 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1 (10 3/4-ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup 1 (10 3/4-ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup 2 (8-ounce) packages sliced mushrooms 1 (16-ounce) carton LAND O LAKES® Sour Cream

Noodles Ingredients:

8 cups hot cooked egg noodles

Chopped fresh parsley

Combine all stroganoff ingredients except sour cream and noodles and parsley in slow cooker. Cover; cook on Low heat setting for 6 to 8 hours, or High heat setting for 4 to 5 hours or until beef is tender. Stir in sour cream just before serving. Serve over hot noodles; sprinkle with parsley.

ObjectName.value: Easy beef stew recipe - A Delicious Twist on a Classic Stew- Chinese Irish Beef Stew

Categories.value: Cuisine of Ireland|Cuisine of China|Media from YouTube|Beef-based food|License review needed (video)|Uploaded with video2commons|Shokuiku Cuisine

ImageDescription.value:
how to make a fusion of flavors beef stew, Chinese Irish beef stew
  1. beefrecipe

Ingredients: • 500g casserole beef steak, cut into cubes • 280g carrots, peeled and chopped into bite-sized pieces • 280g new potatoes, peeled and chopped into bite-sized pieces • 150g celery, chopped into bite-sized pieces • 2 onions, chopped • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 7g ginger, minced • Sprig of thyme • 1 tsp dark brown sugar • 2 tsp light soy sauce • 1 tbsp tomato purée • 3 tsp dark soy sauce • 75ml red wine • 100ml beef stock or water • Chopped parsley for garnish

Instructions: 1. Season the beef cubes with salt, pepper, dark brown sugar, set aside. 2. Heat a sauté pan over medium heat and fry the chopped onion until golden. Add the celery, carrot, potato, and garlic, and mix well. Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and let simmer. If the mixture starts to dry out, add a bit of water and stir well, but be careful not to burn the bottom. 3. In a separate frying pan, fry the beef cubes with thyme, ginger and garlic until all the liquid has evaporated. Transfer the beef cubes to the sauté pan and arrange the cubes on top of the vegetables. Cover with a lid and continue simmering. 4. Pour the red wine into the frying pan to deglaze it. Add the tomato puree and mix well. Add the beef stock or water and dark soy sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and let the sauce simmer for a bit. Pour the sauce into the sauté pan and stir well until all the vegetables and beef are covered with sauce. Cover with a lid and continue simmering for about 1 hour. Serve the stew with boiled brown rice and garnish with chopped parsley.
